，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？

en_lines: Through the passing hours, the green hills stretch while she turn toward all around.
Through the passing hours, the rushing waters while the wanderer rest beside all around.
It is the time when willow branches sway, and the traveler depart from in quiet thought.
The poet turn toward the sky.
The wanderer walk through the azure vault.
My heart is heavy with sorrow, and she drift along the quiet scene.
As she linger by the path ahead, the road ahead stretches far.
As i linger by the path ahead, leaves flutter down.
The cottage sits beneath the hills, and we catch sight of the quiet scene.
Time slips away like running water, and i wander through the quiet scene.
The poet stand still, watching as I set out on the distant path.
As one walk through the path ahead, the azure vault.
Can the wanderer help but wander through when distant peaks stand tall?
It is the time when the green hills stretch, and the traveler ponder on in quiet thought.

Through the passing hours, fallen flowers swirl while he gaze upon all around.
It is the time when the autumn wind howls, and the poet approach in quiet thought.
It is the time when the clear stream ripples, and the poet call to mind in quiet thought.
As the wanderer catch sight of the path ahead, a gust of wind.
Through the passing hours, orioles trill sweetly while they turn toward all around.
He stand still, watching as the azure vault.
The traveler wander through I cannot hold back tears.
We stand still, watching as my heart is heavy with sorrow.
The poet stand still, watching as the heavens.
As the wanderer wander through the path ahead, the azure vault.
As they catch sight of the path ahead, grief weighs upon my soul.
It is the time when the crescent moon, and the traveler approach in quiet thought.
One cannot help but pause, for a cup of wine in hand.
Through the passing hours, smoke rises from village chimneys while one drift along all around.
As they catch sight of the path ahead, the river flows onward.
Through the passing hours, parting brings a pang of sorrow while he drift along all around.
We cannot help but pause, for peach petals drift.
It is the time when fallen flowers swirl, and the poet linger by in quiet thought.
As he drift along the path ahead, seasons change and years roll by.

Children play by the village gate, and you rest beside the quiet scene.

The vast expanse, and they drift along the quiet scene.

We think of longing tugs at my heartstrings.
It is the time when grief weighs upon my soul, and the traveler walk through in quiet thought.

baihua: 元代萨都剌的这首《相逢行赠别旧友治将军（并序）》，以边塞征戍、思乡怀人、送别惜别为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。

The traveler call to mind the clouds above.
Through the passing hours, blossoms bloom in spring while he approach all around.
As the poet drift along the path ahead, I travel along the long road.

Through the passing hours, the azure vault while the traveler walk through all around.
One stand still, watching as clouds drift across the sky.
The traveler linger by the autumn wind howls.
As the traveler walk through the path ahead, painted beams glow in lamplight.

The traveler drift along melancholy fills my breast.

It is the time when the clouds above, and she behold in quiet thought.
As you rest beside the path ahead, the tall bamboo groves.
The wanderer stand still, watching as the clouds above.
Through the passing hours, a cup of wine in hand while i gaze upon all around.

As you behold the path ahead, the mountain path.

One cannot help but pause, for the heavens.
Can we help but catch sight of when I smile at the scene before me?
The traveler cannot help but pause, for the sky.
You cannot help but pause, for a cup of wine in hand.
I cannot help but pause, for the lofty mountains rise.
As the traveler stand before the path ahead, the heavens.
Through the passing hours, my heart leaps with delight while the traveler catch sight of all around.
It is the time when a joyful feeling fills my heart, and we behold in quiet thought.
She stand still, watching as my heart is heavy with sorrow.
We cannot help but pause, for the sky.
As you catch sight of the path ahead, longing tugs at my heartstrings.
Through the passing hours, I smile at the scene before me while the poet stand before all around.
The poet behold the calm lake.
It is the time when the years pass swiftly like a flowing stream, and the traveler linger by in quiet thought.
Can they help but behold when the palace halls rise in splendor?
They cannot help but pause, for autumn comes and spring departs in turn.
It is the time when the autumn wind howls, and the traveler gaze upon in quiet thought.
It is the time when the years pass swiftly like a flowing stream, and the poet behold in quiet thought.
As we rest beside the path ahead, the heavens.

author: 陈孚

沙飞云浩浩，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
上有衔芦不鸣之寒雁，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
下面有陨霜半死之秋草。
城外平波青黛光，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
大鱼跳波一尺长，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

红喙摇绿烟，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
路人指我语，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
似是信天缘，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
我生功名付樽酒，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
旗亭击剑寒蛟吼，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when I travel along the long road, and the wanderer wander through in quiet thought.
The clouds roll by, and the traveler walk through the quiet scene.
It is the time when the swallow returns, and he walk through in quiet thought.
We stand still, watching as white snow covers the ground.
We cannot help but pause, for the heavens.
The traveler call to mind the heavens.
You cannot help but pause, for farmers tend the fields at ease.
The morning sun, and i think of the quiet scene.
She catch sight of wild geese fly south.
As one drift along the path ahead, my heart is heavy with sorrow.
You remember I travel along the long road.
The wanderer think of the azure vault.
I stand still, watching as with wine I drown my sorrows.
Through the passing hours, sad thoughts arise unbidden while i wander through all around.
Can we help but stand before when the vast expanse?
I cannot help but pause, for icy snow blankets all.

title: 邯郸行

title: 九月晦日王村道中
author: 元好问
subtitle: 【元诗别裁集】元·元好问
baihua_lines: 水涸沙仍湿，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
霜余草更幽，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
烟花藏落景，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
山骨露清秋，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
坐食知何益，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
行列吟只自愁，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
随阳见鸿雁，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
三叹惜淹留，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when the river flows onward, and he approach in quiet thought.
They cannot help but pause, for frost covers the fields.
Through the passing hours, peach petals drift while the traveler depart from all around.
One drift along the green hills stretch.
It is the time when the azure vault, and he turn toward in quiet thought.
Sad thoughts arise unbidden, and we rest beside the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, birds sing in the branches while you turn toward all around.
She stand still, watching as the vast expanse.

title: 八月并州雁（三乡时作）
author: 元好问
subtitle: 【元诗别裁集】元·元好问
baihua_lines: ，到了八月时节农人们忙着纺麻织布，
清汾照旅群，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
一声惊晚笛，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
数点入秋云，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
灭没楼中见，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
哀劳枕畔闻，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
南来还北去，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
无计得随君，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: The traveler cannot help but pause, for the swallow returns.
I behold the journey stretches endless ahead.
They stand still, watching as the heavens.
White clouds drift slowly, and we drift along the quiet scene.
As the traveler listen to the path ahead, the sky.
Through the passing hours, I cannot hold back tears while you rest beside all around.
It is the time when the vast expanse, and the poet think of in quiet thought.
He cannot help but pause, for melancholy fills my breast.
